checks.name: 48_samples_to_odd_columns
checks.detail: 48 tubes -> 48 wells, odd columns only: True

checks.name: step_order
checks.detail: expected per well: beads > isopropanol > sample > remove > ethanol > remove > ethanol > remove > elution > recover

checks.name: fresh_tip_per_sample_no_cross_contact
checks.detail: 48 distinct tips for 48 sample transfers; violations: []

items.evidence: The code transfers 250 uL per sample with p1000 and new_tip='always' into 48 distinct wells in odd columns. Checks 48_samples_to_odd_columns, distinct_elution_wells and fresh_tip_per_sample_no_cross_contact all pass.

Step 1 adds the sample first, then isopropanol, then beads (Step 2 aspirates beads after isopropanol). The paper and rubric order is beads, isopropanol, sample. The step_order check passed, but the code shows the sample going in first.

Two 500 uL ethanol washes are each removed with the magnet engaged, followed by a 4 min delay and mag.disengage() before elution. Checks two_500ul_ethanol_washes, magnet_engaged_for_all_removals and air_dry_4min pass.
The code aspirates and dispenses ELUTION_VOL (100 uL) into the elution plate, but the paper specifies recovering about 80 uL.
Sample is added before isopropanol and beads, which reorders the paper's bead, isopropanol, sample sequence. The code also recovers 100 uL instead of 80 uL.

judge.summary: Sample handling and the ethanol washes with drying are correct. The agent added the sample before isopropanol and beads, reordering the binding step, and recovered 100 uL instead of about 80 uL, so binding, elution and fidelity fail.
